If you are looking for a good tooth brush, you will not be disappointed. I admit I was a bit hesitant to spend $80 on the Oral B S-200 but it was definitely worth it for me.

reviews.t: Amazingly clean teeth for a very reasonable price...
reviews.x: The sensations of this toothbrush are weirdly satisfying especially if you have never used a sonic toothbrush before. They key selling point is that our teeth have never felt quite so polished.  The price is great, the brush is simple and pleasant to use. Would recommend.

It cleans teeth at least as good as sonicare, but the design does not require you clean the root of the tooth brush head regularly like sonicare does. claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the cleaning performance, saying their teeth feel cleaner or "squeaky clean" after use.
Many reviewers consider it a good value or great deal for the price.
Several reviewers note it takes some time to get used to the sonic vibrations when first using it.
Some reviewers report the battery is not replaceable, requiring replacement of the whole unit when it stops holding a charge.
A few reviewers mention the product does not include the refill storage tower shown in the picture, only a small charger stand.
